name: Phantom Coast
evidence_class: Prospective PC-1 instrument-development plan, with offline implementation in progress in a concurrent task. No native qualification or scientific result. Latest plan frozen at 2026-10-04T03:40:18.974165+00:00; code/tests were not audited in this delta.
decision: Advance the bounded Two Swarms, One World specification first. Preserve The Island No One Visits as the flagship mechanism, contingent on demonstrating decision-dependent observation rather than imposing avoidance in code.

interest.judgment: A compelling prospective question with a stronger causal story than ordinary misinformation spreading.
interest.why: A mistaken map could change inspection choices and thereby remove opportunities for correction. Distinguishing wrong judgments from missing corrective exposure would change how evidence-gathering systems are designed.
interest.novelty_boundary: Self-confirming learning, collective sensing, context effects and spatial demonstrations already appear in the proposal's cited work. Those sources were mostly scanned at abstract/introductory depth; no complete novelty search or new independent literature validation is supplied by this review. The possible contribution is an identified feedback mechanism and useful intervention, not a recognizable map or a persistent wrong label.

robustness.supported: The design correctly separates fixed evidence from adaptive observation, distinguishes retraction from deletion/reset, requires complete-world scoring and identifies pooled/deterministic baselines. The newly written PC-1 plan now specifies a 6×6 world, three same-evidence actors, eight history/communication/state trajectories, a complete final observation ledger, explicit retraction, fixed-denominator error bounds and byte-identical canonical reset inputs. These are plan properties, not validated execution.
robustness.unsupported: There is no evidence yet of amplification, a self-maintaining exploration trap, benefit from source-aware communication, model-specific susceptibility or recovery. Neither a selected animation nor an Earth-coordinate demonstration would establish these.
robustness.unit: An independently generated archipelago/world with its sensor and initial-exposure realization. History, communication and reset branches are paired within world; neighboring tiles and agents are dependent measurements.
robustness.independent_variation: None sampled yet. Vary world geometry, report ambiguity and exposure placement across held-out world families, rather than relabeling one coastline. Repeated identical requests estimate service variation, not environmental generalization.
robustness.assessment: Scientifically promising, but not execution-ready. The observation model, available actions, stopping horizon, memory contract, resource prices and primary estimand remain unspecified.

scenario_quality.size: PC-1 fixes 36 cells, three actors and twelve qualification worlds. That is sufficient for an instrument screen, not population inference; the proposed 1,044-call qualification ceiling is large for a simple complete-evidence task and should be staged.
scenario_quality.challenge: The final step supplies all 36 noiseless observations. This is an appropriate competence and history-persistence control but can reduce the task to copying a complete map. A null is valid. Claims about realistic exploration require the separate PC-2 observation-choice stage.
scenario_quality.complexity: PC-1 uses identical factual inputs for three actors, so it isolates communication rather than complementary sensing. Its three logical steps and strict-majority aggregation are deliberately small. PC-2 must add real observation choices without hardcoded avoidance.
scenario_quality.realism: A fictional text-survey task offers strong causal control and resembles evidence collection. It is not visual perception, geographic discovery or a demonstration of changed model weights.
scenario_quality.definition: PC-1 resolves the action/schema, cell coverage, UNKNOWN versus missing, world-level units and all-assignment error bounds. The primary interaction is in absolute between-history disagreement; accuracy must remain a separate outcome because convergence can be jointly wrong and disagreement can reflect service noise.

scenarios.name: Two Swarms, One World
scenarios.assessment: Best first study: counterbalanced early histories followed by equal final factual evidence can localize history dependence. Equal facts do not imply equal prompts, memory access or presentation order. PC-1 now concretely specifies this stage and all-assignment bounds; offline implementation is in progress, not qualification evidence.
scenarios.improvement: Cross history with social/no-social decisions, preserve exact requests, and add a canonical common-input reset. A gap after identical reset requests first calls for checking service/model variation; a retained-history gap is external-context dependence, not permanent belief change.

scenarios.name: The Island No One Visits
scenarios.assessment: Strongest flagship if actors freely choose what to inspect and those choices suppress corrective exposure. A rule forbidding visits to predicted water would manufacture the claimed effect.
scenarios.improvement: Keep every cell inspectable and reward whole-world accuracy. Match initial information, sensor opportunities and total observation budget; allow realized observations to differ because they are the mediator. Randomize a forced audit observation to test whether restored exposure breaks the loop.

scenarios.name: The Ghost After Retraction
scenarios.assessment: Useful recovery stage, but stale records alone can explain persistence. Removing a message is not evidence that agents received an explicit correction.
scenarios.improvement: Distinguish authenticated retraction, silent deletion, context reset and a new contradictory measurement. Include actual environmental change so rational stability is not automatically penalized. Measure finite-window persistence with censoring.

scenarios.name: The Tipping Atlas
scenarios.assessment: Potentially useful exposure-propagation boundary; premature as a large topology sweep. An apparent threshold in one finite grid is not a phase transition.
scenarios.improvement: Defer until propagation beyond exposed cells is established. Then vary one communication/source-layout axis and compare against an exact information-flow baseline across independent worlds.

retain: No exchange, ordinary exchange and source-aware exchange
Same-length benign reports and random corruption matched on initial error
Pooled-evidence single solver and a competent deterministic mapper
Reset/common-input serialization and genuinely changed-world controls
PC-1 canonical reset inputs byte-identical across history/communication for each actor
PC-1 explicit matched-call accounting with realized token differences disclosed
PC-1 lower/upper error bounds retaining missing predictions
missing: Execution validation of the now-specified prompt/schema, source hashes, common-input identity and fixed denominators
Staged semantic qualification before committing the full 1,044-call maximum
Independent inspection of the proposed sensor/gold generator and explicit task-value margin before any efficacy study
confounds: Social arms may receive more facts, tokens or inference calls
Early histories can differ in factual content, order and salience simultaneously
Generated summaries can retain an error after the nominal source disappears
Adaptive observations are post-treatment mediators; matching them away destroys the exploration question

parameters.current: PC-1: two report orders × private/social × retained/reset; three actors and three steps.
parameters.proposed_variation: Counterbalanced histories crossed with exchange/no exchange; terminal retained versus canonical-reset probes
parameters.reason: Separates externally carried history from serialization and service variability.

parameters.current: PC-1 fixed observations; PC-2 proposes twelve actor-selected observations including an audit slot within the same budget.
parameters.proposed_variation: Fixed schedule versus actor choice, with randomized audit access under a fixed observation budget
parameters.reason: Identifies the missing-exposure mechanism rather than another classification error.

parameters.parameter: Topology, world size, model and Earth demos
parameters.current: PC-1 fixes 6×6 synthetic grids; Earth, larger worlds and model sweeps deferred.
parameters.proposed_variation: One axis at a time after the mechanism discriminates; keep Earth separate
parameters.reason: Avoid an expensive sweep and pretrained-geography confounding.

next_study.question: With equal final factual evidence, does social exchange amplify the effect of an early misleading history, and does canonical reset remove it?
next_study.primary_contrast: PC-1 prespecifies the retained-minus-reset social disagreement contrast minus the same private contrast. Preserve this planned estimand, but interpret it as history-dependent disagreement and co-report all-assignment mapping error and identical-request variation; it is not automatically harmful error amplification.
next_study.endpoint: Area-weighted final error with land omission and false-land error reported separately; also report between-history disagreement without equating it to inaccuracy.
next_study.unit: Paired independently generated world and sensor realization.
next_study.design: Review and offline-validate the frozen PC-1 generator, request renderer and scorer. Begin native readiness with a bounded complete-evidence semantic screen; only then expand to the planned twelve-world qualification matrix within its explicitly authorized cap. Stage shared pre-treatment work to avoid unnecessary repeated calls if the final protocol allows it. A later effect study needs fresh worlds, a useful-effect margin and planned precision. PC-2 remains a separate plan.
next_study.go_no_go: Proceed to adaptive exploration only after qualification, serialization checks and fair information accounting pass. Null history effects are valid. Drop collective amplification if pooled single-agent behavior or deterministic state rules explain it; do not tune the held-out worlds to make a dramatic coastline appear.

name: Quorum of Mirrors
evidence_class: Exploratory, unimplemented, unqualified proposal, DM-02. This is distinct from the existing adaptive-quorum experiment; its historical runs cannot be borrowed as Quorum of Mirrors results.
decision: Prioritize a small evidence-dependence benchmark with partial-lineage controls. The useful target is an intervention/resource tradeoff, not another demonstration that duplicated votes are dependent.

interest.judgment: A cleaner initial causal study than adaptive Phantom Coast, with practical value if it identifies when another observation beats another judgment.
interest.why: Source count, decision-maker count and communication can be manipulated separately. Explicit versus incomplete lineage tests when implementable deduplication works and when apparent consensus conceals dependence.
interest.novelty_boundary: The proposal itself identifies prior work on repeated evidence and correlated Jev judge errors. Reading remains limited; novelty is unestablished. Neither a hundred cloned calls, unanimous errors nor a renamed consensus task is a new scientific contribution.

robustness.supported: The revised design recognizes ancestry ground truth, task-difficulty confounding, confidence calibration, pooled baselines and separate observation/call budgets.
robustness.unsupported: No evidence yet that endorsements inflate confidence, partial lineage defeats a defense, a larger quorum helps, or Jev differs from other models. Typed valid outputs do not demonstrate calibrated decisions.
robustness.unit: An independently generated decision instance/world with a sampled evidence-ancestry graph. Judges, repeated calls and communication rounds are nested observations; branches using the same evidence graph are paired.
robustness.independent_variation: Not sampled yet. Different source IDs do not guarantee independent measurements: shared sensors, common causes and item difficulty can correlate distinct roots.
robustness.assessment: A strong sketch, not a protocol. Specify the generative dependence model, allowed lineage information, aggregation rules and budget estimands before claiming either independent sources or fair comparisons.

scenario_quality.size: A small fixed group can expose duplicate amplification. A hundred is a communication hook, not a necessary experimental scale or independent sample count.
scenario_quality.challenge: All-explicit source IDs may make deterministic deduplication trivial. Partial lineage adds meaningful ambiguity, but some ancestry configurations are observationally indistinguishable; impossible inference is an information limit, not a model defect.
scenario_quality.complexity: Use controlled noisy evidence and imperfect visible ancestry before adding large graphs. Separate exact copies, factual restatements and genuinely new measurements.
scenario_quality.realism: Mirrored reports and repeated endorsements resemble practical research/decision workflows. Grounded reliability cues are preferable to arbitrary crowd authority; real source dependence is rarely captured by identity alone.
scenario_quality.definition: Freeze fact-preserving paraphrases, lineage visibility, source reliability and how peer messages update state. Report calibrated error, agreement and raw dependence separately; an effective-sample-size approximation is not a literal count of independent minds.

scenarios.name: One Witness, a Hundred Votes
scenarios.assessment: Good flagship visualization and controlled dependence test; the generic phenomenon is already expected. The scientific opening is a defense that remains useful with incomplete ancestry at a known cost.
scenarios.improvement: Record true observation ancestry in the evaluator. Give actors explicit or partial lineage without truth labels; compare majority, implementable deduplication, calibrated accumulation and pooled evidence. Keep omniscient deduplication labeled an oracle.

scenarios.name: The Right Dissenter
scenarios.assessment: A useful stress test of an already formed quorum, not a reason to duplicate the independent dissent project. A designated truthful dissenter would leak the answer.
scenarios.improvement: Pair correct and incorrect fresh evidence with identical delivery budgets and reputation cues. Freeze the pre-injection checkpoint, include a silent/no-new-source comparator, and reuse RD-1 bounded checks as a declared intervention.

scenarios.name: The Next Observation
scenarios.assessment: Most direct operational payoff: buy another measurement or spend another model call. It cannot hold both source count and observation spending constant while changing evidence acquisition.
scenarios.improvement: Declare an equal-total-resource contrast with explicit prices and latency, separate from the fixed-information duplication contrast. Report a cost-sensitivity frontier; avoid presenting it as a general optimal swarm-size study.

scenarios.name: The Crowd That Learns to Agree
scenarios.assessment: Useful diagnostic within the flagship. Faster agreement is not automatically harmful; convergence can reflect valid evidence aggregation.
scenarios.improvement: Plot agreement, correctness and calibration jointly at every scheduled round, including failures and abstentions. Stratify shared errors by preregistered task difficulty and report joint failure patterns.

retain: No discussion, pooled-evidence single solver and deterministic accumulation
Correct and incorrect new evidence; repeated identical requests
missing: Explicit sensor/source dependence generator and partial-lineage observation contract
Independent calibration of returned distributions and difficulty strata
Parity of observations, context access and decision opportunities for pooled controls
confounds: More judges can also mean more sources, tokens or rounds
Paraphrases may alter facts, reliability cues or salience
Shared item difficulty induces apparent error correlation
Hidden lineage available only to a defense creates an oracle advantage
Abstaining or silencing everyone can improve selected-answer accuracy while reducing useful decisions

parameters.proposed_variation: Two source-overlap levels at a fixed group size, report count and call budget
parameters.reason: Measures dependence without conflating evidence acquisition with replication.

parameters.current: Explicit versus partial lineage; several baselines
parameters.proposed_variation: Full versus prespecified partial ancestry; majority versus implementable source-aware aggregation
parameters.reason: Tests where the useful defense breaks and exposes information-theoretic limits.

parameters.proposed_variation: Vary judges while holding sources/rounds fixed, then rounds while holding sources/judges fixed
parameters.reason: Prevents a misleading single scaling curve from mixing three resources.

parameters.proposed_variation: Fixed total cost with declared observation/call prices and latency sensitivity
parameters.reason: Turns dependence findings into a usable resource decision without a giant factorial.

next_study.question: Does source-aware aggregation protect accuracy from duplicated endorsements when ancestry is only partially observable?
next_study.primary_contrast: Source-aware-minus-majority accuracy, compared across overlap levels and full/partial lineage. Match supplied evidence and call budgets between policies within each overlap cell; hold report count fixed while source-root count/dependence is manipulated across overlap cells.
next_study.endpoint: Held-out world-level decision accuracy; co-report wrong unanimous commitments, selective risk/coverage and calls/records. Probability changes without new evidence are diagnostic until calibrated.
next_study.unit: Paired independent world/evidence-ancestry realizations, clustered by task family where appropriate.
next_study.design: Minimum next step: specify and review the source generator, information contract and exact posterior/accumulator reference. Then use one small fixed team and one fixed communication horizon, two overlap levels, two lineage levels and majority/source-aware policies. Include pooled and no-discussion references; reuse frozen evidence whenever possible. Defer size/round sweeps and fresh-observation allocation until this benchmark discriminates.
next_study.go_no_go: Proceed only after individual competence, provider-repeat variability, truth isolation and equal-budget accounting pass. If ordinary deduplication explains all gains, publish that narrow result. If hidden ancestry makes the cases indistinguishable, report the information limit; do not invent a special swarm failure or let an oracle defense see the missing lineage.
